newsitem.title: LATVIA: NORWAY'S HAKON TO OPEN SECOND RIGA SUPERMARKET.
newsitem.headline: NORWAY'S HAKON TO OPEN SECOND RIGA SUPERMARKET.

text.p: Norwegian retail company Hakon Group said on Tuesday that it was set to open a second of its Rimi chain of supermarkets in Riga.
The new store, which will be in the Purvciems district of the city on Nicgale, will join the first store, which was opened in the Dole centre at the end of Maskavas.
The new store will be 2,200 square metres and has had investments of one million dollars, Varner Hakon Invest, part of the Hakon Group, said in a statement.
The company also said that it had various projects this year, including opening a shopping at the central railway station. It said it planned to have 10 shops in Latvia by the end of next year.
